messages:
elaine: dropping a tiny 'sprint goal bites' pack for reviews  one-liners for ICs + 2-line manager comments. includes hiring tie-ins and a benefits/policy example. copy-paste friendly.

raf: love the name. can you include a short "evidence" line so managers can anchor claims?
don: also add a 1-line hiring impact KR for folks who mentor new hires.
elaine: good call both  added. short and scannable. people-ops-bot: Heads up: review window opens next Mon; include thread_ts to request template addition.

elaine: --- SPRINT GOAL BITE (pasteable one-liners) ---
- Role elevator: "I own [area] by [action] to improve [customer/org outcome]."
- Outcome metric: "Reduced p99 latency from 780ms -> 260ms on critical routes."
- Hiring impact (1 line): "Mentored 2 hires; reduced their time-to-first-PR from 4w to 10d."
- Benefit/policy KR (1 line): "Documented GDPR dataflow and automated opt-out handling, cutting manual reviews by 60%."
- Quick tweak note: "Would start A/B tests earlier to avoid late rollbacks."

elaine: --- MANAGER 2-LINER (paste) ---
- Evidence: "Validated changes in canary and prod dashboards; saw p99 drop and stable error rates."
- Next action: "Assign owner for runbook and schedule a 3-week checkpoint to confirm adoption."

elaine: --- PEER DM TEMPLATES (one-line) ---
- Fast ask: "Hey @NAME  2 quick lines on my clarity during the rollout (handoff + responsiveness)? Thx!"
- Hiring ask: "Hey @NAME  could you note how my mentorship went for the new hire I supported? 1-2 lines is perfect."

raf: short + practical. I like the GDPR example for policy folks. don: will paste into my direct reports' review notes.
elaine: if folks want, I can make a PM/design variant with product metrics instead of latency.
people-ops-bot: Tip: to add these as quick templates in the review form, file a ticket and reference this thread_ts.
root_message: elaine: dropping a tiny 'sprint goal bites' pack for reviews \u007f one-liners for ICs + 2-line manager comments. includes hiring tie-ins and a benefits/policy example. copy-paste friendly.
